question.text: A projectile thrown with an initial velocity of $10 \mathrm{ms}^{-1}$ at an angle $\alpha$ with the horizontal. has a range of $5 \mathrm{m}$. Taking $g=10 \mathrm{ms}^{-2}$ and neglecting air resistance, what will he the estimated value of $\alpha$?

solution.text:
Given, initial velocity of particle,
$$
u=10 \mathrm{ms}^{-1}
$$
Range, $R=5 \mathrm{m}$ Gravitational acceleration,
$$
g=10 \mathrm{ms}^{-2}
$$
As we known that, 
Range of projectile, $R=\frac{u^{2} \sin 2 \theta}{g}$
or
$$
\begin{aligned}
5 &=\frac{(10)^{2} \sin 2 \alpha}{10} \\
\sin 2 \alpha &=\frac{5}{10} \\
\sin 2 \alpha &=\frac{1}{2} \\
\alpha &=15^{\circ} \\
\left(90^{\circ}-15^{\circ}\right.&\left.=75^{\circ}\right)
\end{aligned}
$$
